name: connector.status
title: Connector and Core runtime status
summary: Cheap, pollable snapshot for the Dashboard. Deliberately does not claim anything about whether traffic reaches the VPS -- that is server.test, which measures egress (master prompt 13).

appliedConfigHash.description: Lowercase sha256 of the config Core is running right now, or null when nothing is applied. This is the same quantity config.snapshot#/result/appliedConfigHash reports and the same value config.apply#/result/configHash returned when that config was applied -- one number, three commands. scripts/verify.mjs asserts the identity of the hash definition across protocol/commands/*.json and that every hash a status command reports in protocol/fixtures/protocol was produced by a mutating command somewhere in the corpus (a drift-flagged frame excepted).
